name: nexus-monorepo
description: Repository-level orchestration for the Nexus applications

scripts.install:codex: npm ci --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-api && npm ci --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-processor && npm ci --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-websocket && npm ci --prefix apps/codex/services/admin-ui && npm ci --prefix apps/codex/services/dm-ui && npm ci --prefix apps/codex/docs
scripts.build:codex: npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-api run build && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-processor run build && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-websocket run build && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/admin-ui run build && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/dm-ui run build && npm --prefix apps/codex/docs run build
scripts.test:forge: npm --prefix apps/forge run lint && npm --prefix apps/forge run test -- --run --coverage
scripts.test:codex: npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-api test -- --runInBand src/services/__tests__/processing-quality.service.test.ts && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-processor test -- --runInBand && npm --prefix apps/codex/services/doc-websocket test -- --runInBand --passWithNoTests && npm --prefix apps/codex/docs run typecheck
